policy: Check three distinct 160 ms waveform windows in the known dry command against the received selected Opus stream. Repeat with the recording cut 200 ms into the active source, ending 200 ms early, or with the first 200 ms zeroed in place. Cuts use the archived codec clock and nominal source onset. Also match the same-run microphone command to the Opus capture. Rooms contain physical-response convolution and noise. All controls reuse the same development recordings; three successful windows do not certify intervening audio.
